kind: exploratory amendment prompted by a simulator configuration warning
why: SUMO warns that action intervals longer than the step with Euler may cause collisions. The Euler separation tranche is discontinued; all finished and partial runs remain archived. This is a configuration-validity amendment, not removal of unfavorable outcomes.
contrasts: Fixed step 0.5: action 0.5 vs 1.0. Fixed action 0.5: step 0.5 vs 0.1. Compare tau within setting, never label cross-setting differences a treatment effect.
legacy_comparison: Existing Euler 0.5/0.5 provides an integration comparison, not a replicate.
limits: One seed is a feasibility check only. Tau 0.8 below action 1.0 is deliberately an invalid-headway stress case, not an engineering recommendation. Junction collision checks retain original false; safety validation remains incomplete.
stop_rule: Preserve failures. Stop on execution failure, accounting failure or incompatible integration warning. Retain all response signs and warning counts.
